owner_and_capability: Legacy composition — shared test composition (test-support: test) under #2748, #4014: the shared fixtures stop importing the Enrollment domain (enrollment/domain: models/enrollment). They map the enrollment.care_offerings row they write themselves, take the phase, request, child and care-offering values from Enrollment test support (enrollment/test-support: modules/enrollment/enrollmenttest), and the Timetable template suites create their source offerings through the fixtures instead of the legacy Factory.
atomic_cutover: One test-support change without an ADR or epoch, following #3943 and #3966. CareOffering in test is no longer an alias of models/enrollment.CareOffering but a test-owned row of enrollment.care_offerings (test/care_offering_rows.go, the columns of Care Plan's row mapping that the fixtures write and their callers read; selection_rule, auto_add_grade_levels and pickup_times take the column default when unset). InsertTestCareOffering inserts that row through its tags instead of raw SQL; CreateTestCareOffering and NewSourceCareOffering return it, and the booking consistency fixture updates it by primary key. The phase, request and child values come from modules/enrollment/enrollmenttest, which re-exports them from the public Enrollment package (existing rule test-support.to.enrollment-support); the care-offering values fixed and parent_choice have no constant in a public owner package, so enrollmenttest names them as the stored column values; the Timetable source offering takes the selection rule optional from the column default. The Timetable suites insert their source offerings with InsertTestCareOffering instead of Factory.EnrollmentCareOfferingRows().Create; the Care Plan create path they bypass validated the offering and its linked template under the template-recurrence lock and wrote an empty selection_group, where the fixture leaves it NULL; the suites assert neither, and Care Plan's own catalog suites keep covering that path. Factory.EnrollmentCareOfferingRows had no other caller and is deleted. The type check over every package with tests found one other caller to rewrite: the Care Plan lifecycle authority suite builds the fixture row instead of the model. No rule, no fixture target and no key is added; one key falls (60 -> 59). No route, status code, error string, table or write owner changes.
